title: Free Auto Farm, Party & Auto Evo ( Open Source ) New
features:
Features

- Master Auto Farm with customizable task priorities

- Auto Join Map by world, mode, difficulty, and act

- Automatic Gear farming with persistent queues

- Automatic Unit farming with drop-map detection

- Trait Map farming with priority and difficulty settings

- Daily and Regular Challenge Sniper

- Auto Quest, Evo, Craft, and Stat Reroll

- Automatic Merchant, Raid Shop, and Event Shop purchases

- Auto Battlepass, milestones, rewards, and code redemption

- In-game Auto Play, replay, speed, ultimate, and leave failsafes

- Multi-account Party Mode with Host and Member roles

- Local daily farming and resource statistics

- Auto reconnect, server hop, and Anti-AFK

- English and Vietnamese interface

- Persistent settings and farming queues

- No inventory or account data sent externally

- Completely free and open source

- No key system or paywall

If you find the script useful, please leave the project a star:

https://github.com/Truyem/Anime-Squadron
